name: olea-contracts
description: olea-contracts — zod validation for everything crossing the wire, plus the frozen JSON examples that pin it. No Obsidian import, ever (INV-1).
//main: Source, not dist, deliberately — same rule as `types` below. This package is private and never published; the only shipped artifact is the esbuild plugin bundle, which bundles TS source directly. Pointing `main` at dist made every workspace consumer's vitest run depend on olea-contracts having been built first, so `pnpm -r test` failed on a clean clone (CI runs test before build). dist/ remains a build output; nothing in the workspace resolves through it.
//types: Points at source, not dist, deliberately — same rule as olea-core. Consumers in this workspace must typecheck without olea-contracts having been built first: CI runs typecheck before build on a fresh clone, and a warm local dist/ hides the breakage. Source types are also never stale.
